title: Victim loses £250k after scammers use AI video of 'well-known' celebrity

reports.title: Victim loses £250k after scammers use AI video of 'well-known' celebrity

summary:
A person in the Ards and north Down area lost £250,000 in an AI related investment scam, according to the Police Service of Northern Ireland. The victim saw an AI generated video that appeared to feature a well known financial sector personality. It advertised an investment with claimed significant returns. After a small initial payment, the scammers contacted the victim on WhatsApp and pushed for more money. They persuaded the victim to open several online accounts and gave them remote access to their computer, saying they were helping with the investment.

Police called it a sophisticated fraud. The victim was encouraged to borrow money, and the funds went to accounts controlled by criminals. The PSNI did not name the celebrity, though BBC News NI has seen scams using financial experts such as Martin Lewis, Peter Jones and Steven Bartlett. Superintendent Joanne Gibson of the Scamwise Partnership urged people to stop and check financial activity and for families to discuss fraud. Police advised verifying who people are dealing with and checking Financial Conduct Authority authorization.
